idea-plugin.name: Midnight Tide
idea-plugin.description:
Midnight Tide

A cool-blue dark theme built for JetBrains' Islands layout. Forked directly from Islands Dark with three surgical changes:

  • Editor background remapped to #151719 on a cooler chrome tier
  • Teal accent (#0891B2) for selection, focus rings, and the action button
  • Diff line colors swapped to JetBrains' deuteranopia palette — colorblind-safe out of the box

Syntax highlighting keeps JetBrains' own dark colors (orange keywords, purple fields, green strings). Selection, gutter, popups, and all ~190 other color keys carry over from Islands Dark verbatim.

Also included: Midnight Tide Bioluminescence. The same night-blue base with glowing accents: seafoam strings, peach numbers, orchid types, italic keywords, a seafoam caret, a deep-teal status bar and highlighted TODO comments.

Setup: Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Appearance → Theme → Midnight Tide. Then Settings → Editor → Color Scheme → Midnight Tide (or Midnight Tide Bioluminescence). For the floating-panel look, also enable "Different tool window background" in the Appearance settings.

Requires IDE 2025.3+ for the Islands Dark parent theme.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.2 — No changes to the themes; the description now shows both themes in IntelliJ IDEA, and describes the syntax colors as they are.

1.1.1 — No changes to the theme; released alongside screenshots for the VS Code listing.

1.1.0 — New theme: Midnight Tide Bioluminescence, a more colorful variant with seafoam, peach and orchid syntax colors, italic keywords, a seafoam caret, a deep-teal status bar and highlighted TODO comments.

1.0.4 — No changes to the JetBrains theme; released alongside the VS Code port's comment-contrast and terminal-color fixes to keep both versions in step.

1.0.3 — Compatibility fixed: the plugin now declares 2025.3+ (it was listed as 2024.1+, where its Islands Dark parent theme does not exist), and it is built and verified against the current IntelliJ Platform.

1.0.2 — Updated vendor/publisher to Chelayel.

1.0.1 — Coral search field text; unified true-error palette around coral #E88F89 (errors no longer collide with amber warnings); lifted indent guides and caret-row; faint resting scrollbar; bright-red and bright-green terminal colors actually read as red/green; link color separated from teal accent.

1.0.0 — Initial release.
